headline: Alt-right troll Milo Yiannopoulos has been deported
summary: Milo Yiannopoulos was arrested by ICE for overstaying his visa. He failed to appear for an immigration hearing. DHS confirmed his deportation to the UK.

headline: Sony Music and Warner Chappell are suing Anthropic
summary: Sony Music and Warner Chappell sued Anthropic for copyright infringement. They claim Anthropic used 'tens of thousands' of copyrighted works. Companies seek up to $150,000 per work plus damages for stripped copyright data.

headline: Distraction-free writing gadget BYOK is adding custom extensions
summary: BYOK, a single-purpose writing gadget, is gaining custom extension support. It's designed for pure text focus and minimizing distractions. This update enhances its utility for dedicated writers.

headline: Welcome to Night Vale cocreator Joseph Fink learned storytelling from Grim Fandango
summary: Joseph Fink, cocreator of 'Welcome to Night Vale', credits Grim Fandango for teaching him storytelling. He is also behind other successful podcasts like Unlicensed and Alice Isn't Dead. Fink explores various genres, from cosmic horror to serious relationship dramas.

headline: The Witcher 4 Will Have a Physical Edition Even if Discs Go Away, CD Projekt Red Confirms
summary: CD Projekt Red confirms 'The Witcher 4' will have a physical edition. This commitment stands even if Sony stops disc support by 2028. Collectors can still expect a physical 'box' for the game.

headline: Anne Hathaway Cast Opposite Tom Cruise in Days of Thunder Sequel
summary: Anne Hathaway joins Tom Cruise in the 'Days of Thunder' sequel. She will play a team owner and engineer. The film is slated for a summer 2028 release.

headline: Everything Coming to HBO Max in September
summary: HBO Max announces a strong lineup of new additions for September. The platform continues robust programming despite ongoing industry mergers. Subscribers can look forward to fresh content next month.

headline: Ridley Scott Says Alien: Romulus 'Was OK,' So He's Returning to the Franchise Because It 'Needs Some Help'
summary: Director Ridley Scott deemed 'Alien: Romulus' 'was OK'. He plans to return to the 'Alien' franchise. Scott believes the series 'needs some help'.

headline: At least 37 dead and hundreds evacuated after strike on Kyiv weapons depot
summary: A strike on a Kyiv weapons depot resulted in at least 37 deaths. Hundreds of residents were evacuated from the area. An investigation is underway into the storage of military weapons near a residential zone.

headline: Cleverly quits shadow cabinet to run for London mayor
summary: Cleverly has resigned from the shadow cabinet. He intends to run for London mayor. The next mayoral election is scheduled for 2028.

headline: Norway's new king remembers 'my dear father' in first speech
summary: Haakon VIII delivered his first speech as Norway's new king. He paid an emotional tribute to his late father, Harald V. The new monarch also outlined his intentions for his reign.

headline: Royal Navy warships track Russian vessels for three days in UK waters
summary: Royal Navy warships tracked four Russian vessels in UK waters for three days. HMS Duncan, HMS St Albans, and HMS Severn monitored their passage. The Russian ships were observed in the North Sea and English Channel.
